svg.aria-label: Showtime - Music Video Lab: three music videos. Songs made in Suno, pictures from text prompts, animation in Remotion with Three.js, every visual event locked to a measured beat, Claude Code as the main loop. Tracks: Merge Conflict 3:52, Her Sabah Bastan 4:01, Vorathul: NERFED 4:33.
